name: Galar Gym Gauntlet
description: The Galar Gym Leaders and Champion Leon with canonical Sword story teams.
mechanics_assumptions: Canonical story-mode species and order are preserved in Original teams mode
The pinned Gen 9 NatDex Draft validator supplies legal modern move and ability details
Regional campaign levels are normalized to the shared 25-to-100 progression

source.variant: Canonical Gym/Trial, Elite Four and Champion story rosters
source.compatibility_note: Story rosters are presented in the current NatDex Draft battle format.
